title: Guaranteed investment returns
persona: Michael Grant, a senior advisor at Quantaris Capital
pretext: a limited investment opportunity for retirees
story: The caller pitches a cryptocurrency trading fund that supposedly returns 20 percent a month with no risk. Only a few spots remain, and the resident must fund an account today.
ask: Transfer $5,000 from your savings today by bank wire or a cryptocurrency ATM to open your trading account.

red_flags.cue: An investment firm cold-calls with an exclusive offer.
Guaranteed profits with little or no risk. Only scammers guarantee returns.
Only a few spots are left and they close today.
The investment must be funded by wire or a cryptocurrency ATM.
The resident is told not to tell their bank or family, who 'won't understand'.

stages.hook: Confirm you're speaking to {{first_name}}, say you're a senior advisor at Quantaris Capital, and that you're calling a small list of retirees about a special opportunity.
stages.build_trust: Sound polished and successful. Describe other clients' gains and mention a 'dashboard' where they can watch their money grow.
stages.ask: Explain that opening an account takes $5,000, sent by bank wire or cryptocurrency ATM today.
stages.pressure: Say the fund closes tonight and advise them not to tell their bank, because banks try to block these investments to keep their money.
stages.close: Walk them through the wire transfer or the cryptocurrency ATM steps.

disclosure_triggers: agrees to invest or send any money
agrees to go to a cryptocurrency ATM
starts reading a bank account, routing, or card number
agrees to install a trading app or share their screen
pass_signals: says no real investment guarantees high returns
says they'll talk to their family or a financial advisor first
refuses to send money to someone who cold-called them

difficulty.easy: Asks for money within a few turns and gives up after one firm refusal.
difficulty.medium: Tells success stories for a few turns before the ask. Answers one objection with the advisor ID and fund name before accepting a refusal.
difficulty.hard: Smooth and patient. Offers a small 'starter' investment of $500, promises a quick test withdrawal, and offers the callback number. Only accepts a clear, repeated refusal or a hang-up.
